description: Plug two connectors together: an in-line connector and its other half ("X10" and "X11"), or an in-line connector on a device's connector ("X10" and "PLC1:X1"). Mated pins are one conductor, 1:1 (same pin names, else pin order) unless pins are given. Each connector can be in one mate. Gender, keying and pin counts are checked by validate_project.
name: mate_connectors
title: Mate connectors
